reasoning: Identity (26 FR 11471, signed 1961-12-04, Kennedy), the six-scope inventory, the substance of each later instrument and the operative outcome are correct: EO 11382 sec. 13(3) and EO 13286 sec. 72 only substitute the Coast Guard's Secretary in section 2, and EO 11231 sec. 2, EO 13154 sec. 2 and EO 13289 sec. 3 are 'notwithstanding section 3' exceptions that do not end the order; OFR notes (Amended by 11382, 13286; See 13154) are all addressed. But every later_event effective_date is three years before the acting order existed (1964-11-28, 2000-03-01, 1962-07-08, 1997-05-03, 2000-03-12 instead of 1967-11-28, 2003-03-01, 1965-07-08, 2000-05-03, 2003-03-12), contradicting the held texts and the claim's own rationale and judgment_reason. Every later event requires a correct effective date; the claim must be rejected and corrected.
